boot_settle_sec.description: How long a started VM counts as booting (default 180). Only with `max_concurrent_boots`.

defer_retry_interval_sec.description: Wait between admission checks. In seconds, up to seven days.

max_concurrent_boots.description: How many sandbox VMs may boot at once on the node. 0 is unlimited.

max_defer_retries.description: Checks to repeat before the run fails, before it creates anything.

max_host_iowait_percent.description: The most CPU I/O wait that still admits the run.

max_host_ram_percent.description: The most host memory in use, with the recovery's reservation, that still admits the run.

frameworks.description: The framework labels the report prints. A label is not a certification, and the report is not mapped to a framework's controls.

retention_days.description: Days each report is kept (2555 is seven years). Recorded in the report; CertiStack deletes nothing.

rto_target_seconds.description: Recovery time objective in seconds. A run slower than this fails. Leave the key out to set none.

sign_key_path.description: Used by the Enterprise Edition: the controller-local Ed25519 private key that signs the report. The Community Edition accepts the field so that plans stay portable between the editions, ignores it, and writes its reports unsigned. Never sent to the node. Optional.

balloon_mb.description: Balloon target in MiB; not above `memory_mb`.

memory_mb.description: Memory in MiB: 16 or more. 0 inherits.

gateway.description: A sandbox never has a gateway. Not implemented: the plan is refused if this is set.

ip_range.description: IPv4 CIDR of the isolated subnet. No address of the PVE node or the PBS server may lie in it.

ipam.description: Not implemented: the plan is refused if this is set.

lifecycle.description: `ephemeral` (default): CertiStack creates and removes the zone and VNet. `preprovisioned`: a platform-owned sandbox, validated and kept. Any letter case.

mode.description: `simple` for single-node bridges, `vxlan` for multi-node clusters.

mtu.description: Not implemented: the plan is refused if this is set.

peers.description: Comma-separated IP addresses of the VXLAN peers; only for `vxlan`.

probe_ip.description: Address inside `ip_range` the worker probes from; not the network or broadcast address.

tag.description: VXLAN VNI, required for `vxlan` (1 to 16777215) and not allowed for `simple`.

vnet_id.description: PVE SDN VNet ID: a letter, then letters and digits, up to eight characters.

zone_id.description: PVE SDN zone ID: a letter, then letters and digits, up to eight characters.

attach_all_nics.description: Also attach the source's net1 and up to the isolated network.

capture_diagnostics.description: Record guest-side diagnostics when a wire probe fails.

interface_name.description: Linux interface name for a legacy name-bound profile: 1 to 15 characters from letters, digits, '_', '-' and '.'; not "lo", "." or "..".

mode.description: How the guest's network is prepared on its disposable overlay. `preserve` leaves the guest's own configuration. Any letter case.

sandbox_ip.description: The guest's address on the sandbox network: a usable IPv4 address in `network.ip_range`, unique per plan. Not with `preserve`.

base_dn.description: `auto`, or the distinguished name an ldap probe searches.

command.description: The guest-agent command: `hostname`, `guest-get-host-name`, `ping`, `guest-ping`, `systemctl is-active <service>` or `sc query <service>`.

description.description: What the probe asserts, recorded in the report. Defaults to `<type> verification probe`.

domain.description: The name a dns probe resolves, or the SRV record it looks up.

expected_output.description: Text the command's output must contain. Not for `ping`.

expected_status.description: The HTTP status the answer must have, 200 to 599.

insecure_skip_verify.description: A certificate-check bypass is never permitted. Not implemented: the plan is refused if this is set.

naming_context.description: A distinguished name the directory's Root DSE must advertise. Not with `base_dn`.

path.description: The HTTP request target sent exactly as written; for a dns probe, the domain when `domain` is left out.

record_type.description: The DNS record a dns probe asserts: an A or AAAA answer, or an SRV record (needs `domain`). Any letter case.

require_qga.description: A guest agent that does not answer fails the probe instead of skipping it.

retries.description: Extra executions within the timeout. 0 polls until the timeout.

server_name.description: The TLS server name (SNI) the certificate must carry. On an http probe it is also the Host header (a virtual host); on an mssql probe it makes the probe verify a TDS 8.0 strict handshake against the node's trust store.

target_ip.description: Literal IP address inside `network.ip_range` the probe connects to; it belongs to exactly one VM.

timeout_sec.description: The probe's total readiness budget (default 10). In seconds, up to seven days.

tls_skip_verify.description: A certificate-check bypass is never permitted. Not implemented: the plan is refused if this is set.

type.description: What the probe checks. Wire probes (tcp, http, dns, ldap, mssql, smb) run from the worker over the sandbox network; `qga` runs inside the guest; `qmp` and `screendump` only show that the VM runs.

archive.description: The PBS archive file name, for example `drive-scsi0`, without path separators.

slot.description: ide0 to ide3, sata0 to sata5, scsi0 to scsi30 or virtio0 to virtio15.

drive.description: Alias for one entry of `drives`: one backed-up archive, restored to the slot its name gives (`drive-virtio0` is `virtio0`), else `scsi0`.

drives.description: Every backed-up disk to restore, by PVE slot. Not needed with `use_backup_config`.

storage_id.description: `pbs`: the run's one configured PBS endpoint.

max_copy_gib.description: The most copy-before-boot may write in one run, all VMs together. 0 is no cap.

overlay_storage.description: PVE storage ID of a file-based storage with `images` content that holds the disposable qcow2 overlays. Required on stock Proxmox VE.

pbs_fingerprint.description: PBS certificate fingerprint. Prefer PBS_FINGERPRINT in the protected environment file.

pbs_namespace.description: Default PBS namespace for every VM's `source_pbs.namespace`.

pbs_repository.description: PBS repository. Prefer PBS_REPOSITORY in the protected environment file: a plan is kept as evidence.

scratch_dir.description: Node-local private work directory. Not a shared temporary directory such as /tmp.

boot_timeout_sec.description: How long the PVE start task, then QEMU's `running` status, may each take (default 60). In seconds, up to seven days.

level.description: Start order: tiers run in ascending level. Unique across the plan.

soak_time_sec.description: Hold the tier this long after its probes pass, repeating each VM's service probes every 30 seconds. In seconds, up to seven days.

startup_grace_period_sec.description: Wait after the tier's VMs start before probing. In seconds, up to seven days.

bios.description: Explicit PVE BIOS; overrides the inherited one.

copy_before_boot.description: Whether the integrity scan also copies the VM's disks next to its overlays so the sandbox boots from local copies.

hardware_overrides.description: Virtual hardware to use instead of the backup's. 0 or a missing key inherits.

mac.description: Six-octet MAC for the isolated NIC, with colons, hyphens or in dotted groups of four digits. Not all zeros and not a multicast or broadcast address (the first octet is even). Normally inherited from the backup.

machine.description: Explicit PVE machine type, such as `q35`, `pc-i440fx-9.2` or `pc-q35-9.2+pve1`, with options such as `,viommu=virtio`; overrides the inherited one.

name.description: The sandbox VM's name, recorded in the report: a DNS name of at most 63 characters (letters, digits, `-` and `.`, starting and ending with a letter or digit), as Proxmox VE requires.

network_recovery.description: How the guest is given an address on the isolated network, on a disposable copy of its disks.

nic_model.description: PVE network model for the isolated NIC.

ostype.description: Explicit PVE OS type; overrides the inherited one.

probes.description: The checks that decide whether the restored VM works. At least one must assert something in the guest: a wire probe, or a `qga` probe with `require_qga: true`.

require_quiesced_backup.description: Fail the VM before anything is restored unless its backup was quiesced or taken powered off.

require_signed_backup.description: Fail the VM before anything is created unless its backup manifest is signed and CERTISTACK_PBS_KEYFILE verified it.

scsihw.description: Explicit PVE SCSI controller; overrides the inherited one.

source_pbs.description: Which backup to restore. Required unless `storage.pbs_repository` or `source_vmid` supplies it.

source_vmid.description: The protected VM whose backup is restored. Required when `source_pbs.snapshot` is `latest`.

vmid.description: The temporary sandbox VM's ID. It must not exist on the node, and differs from `source_vmid`.

description: A CertiStack restore test plan (version v1). Generated by `certistack schema`; `certistack validate` is the authority.

admission_control.description: How busy the node may be before a run starts. Give this block (or its alias, `admission`), with `max_host_ram_percent`, `max_host_iowait_percent`, `defer_retry_interval_sec` and `max_defer_retries`.

compliance.description: What the report records about the standards it maps to (and, for the Enterprise Edition, which key signs it).

environment.description: Free-text label recorded in the report.

name.description: A human-readable name, recorded in the report. Not empty.

network.description: The isolated sandbox network the restored VMs run on.

plan_id.description: Names the plan in the report and in the report's file path.

storage.description: Overlay storage and optional PBS defaults. Prefer the protected environment file for PBS settings.

tiers.description: The VMs to restore and check, in start order.

use_backup_config.description: Inherit the disk layout and the safe compute and firmware settings from each resolved snapshot.

version.description: The plan format. `certistack/v1` is an accepted alias of `v1`.

title: CertiStack plan
